source.version_stated: Current version as at 01 Oct 2026; PDF created date 01 Oct 2026
source.edition: 2020 Revised Edition, which incorporates all amendments up to and including 1 December 2021 and came into operation on 31 December 2021; the text carries marginal amendments after that date, the latest in the First Schedule being Act 10 of 2025 wef 15/09/2026, Act 21 of 2025 wef 17/08/2026 and S 42/2026 wef 30/01/2026
source.note: Singapore Statutes Online PDF, an unofficial consolidation (SSO Terms of Use cl.8). One vintage: the law as at 01 Oct 2026. The PDF was supplied to the encoder from the user's folder 'SG Acts'; how it was fetched (by hand or by a script) is not known. Text and PDF deposited in source/; see source/PROVENANCE.md.

scope_note: The encoding of this subject covers the First Schedule (Tabular statement of offences under the Penal Code 1871) and the provisions that read it directly (s 2(1) and ss 7 to 9), and the Second Schedule (laws to which criminal case disclosure procedures apply) with ss 159 and 211A. The rest of the Code and the Third to Seventh Schedules are not encoded; see encodings/NOTES.md.

related_subjects.evidence-act-1893: sg/evidence-act-1893: the interface module ea-cpc-interface.l4 is carried identically in both rows; the Code's Part 14 (evidence and witnesses) is not yet encoded
related_subjects.penal-code-1871: sg/penal-code-1871: the First Schedule is a procedural cross-reference to Penal Code sections; the elements of each offence are in that subject
